name: RAGEval
description: RAGEval is a framework for automatically generating evaluation datasets to assess the knowledge usage ability of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems across different vertical domains. It creates diverse question-answer pairs based on generated documents and introduces novel metrics to evaluate completeness, hallucination, and irrelevance in LLM-generated responses.
reputation: A recent framework for RAG evaluation that has seen some research interest, but it is not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Focuses on evaluating RAG systems in vertical domains; avoids confusion about knowledge source in QA; dataset and code to be released.
